summary: Missing person reported off North Sailboard late Thursday afternoon at Lake Pueblo State Park; Pueblo County Sheriff's Office Dive Team recovered the body using an underwater drone in 17 ft of water; body turned over to the Pueblo County Coroner for identification and cause-of-death determination
responding_agency: Pueblo County Sheriff's Office Dive Team; Colorado Parks and Wildlife rangers
notes: KRDO mirror of the CPW-reported incident; 23rd Colorado water death of 2022 if confirmed a drowning | CPR 2022-07-10 story (parent-opened) covers this July-7 death plus a second Lake Pueblo boating fatality on Saturday July 9, inserted as a new row this run.
